name: 海辺
description: A sunny beach in summer. Two children are kneeling on the sand and building a sandcastle with a red flag. One of them is digging with a yellow shovel, and a red bucket is next to them. A seagull is flying away with a sandwich in its beak, and a woman in a pink dress is surprised and reaching up next to a checkered picnic blanket with a basket. A man is sleeping on a striped towel under a red and white beach umbrella with a straw hat on his face. A boy is floating in the sea with a red and white float ring. There is a small sailboat on the sea, two palm trees, a crab and rocks near the water, a surfboard standing in the sand, a beach ball, a cooler, and footprints in the sand.
elements: a child digging with a shovel next to a red bucket
a seagull flying away with a sandwich in its beak
a surprised woman reaching up toward the seagull
